about: The disco light (add-forensic-flashlight), toggled on B. A disco ball floats in front of the player. ball: where it appears when switched on, relative to the eye and the way the player faces (metres: right, up, back; -Z is ahead; about eyebrow level, 1.1 m away and 35 degrees to the left, so it appears at the left edge of the view with about a third of it out of frame (16:9, 45 degree vertical field of view); user, 2026-11-17), and how fast it spins (turns per second). It stays at that place while on. pulse: near a clock (the nearest within reach_m whose beats the engine reports) it swells by depth on each heard beat and settles over decay_seconds. beams: the ring of spotlights it throws (count, colours alternating, sRGB; intensity in lumens; width in degrees; range in metres; tilt below the horizon in degrees, alternating so spots land near and far). reveal: a collectible within range_m and inside width_deg of a beam flares, then fades over fade_seconds. hologram: rim and core colours (sRGB; glow multiplies them for bloom), scanlines per metre and their scroll speed, flicker 0..1. beacon: the column and diamond over each revealed collectible.
